'''Gorwin''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3640 BBY]], when he served as the second-in-command of [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] during the [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|battle]] at [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
